subject: Post-discovery: 30-min intro — concise agenda + 3 demo windows
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Reyes <anna@lumina.ai>, Tom Bradford <tom.bradford@lumina.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-14T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-discovery: 30-min intro — concise agenda + 3 demo windows

Hi Anna / Tom —

Thanks again for your time today. Quick recap from our discovery: Lumina is focused on improving analyst throughput for ad-hoc cohort queries, reducing inference cost for tranche runs, and keeping model behavior auditable for compliance. We heard your priorities as: 1) predictable latency for short queries (under 300 tokens), 2) cost controls across staging vs. prod, and 3) audit logs for model versions.

Next step: a 30-minute product intro/demo tailored to those priorities — we'll show throughput/latency numbers, routing and fallback behavior, and how our cost controls + audit logs look from the Console.

Proposing three short windows (all PT) — please pick one that works or send a preference:
- Option A: Tue Oct 20, 10:00–10:30 AM PT
- Option B: Wed Oct 21, 2:00–2:30 PM PT
- Option C: Thu Oct 22, 11:00–11:30 AM PT

Suggested attendees: someone from Product (to validate persona), someone from Infra/Platform (latency/cost), and a technical PM or data engineer. If you prefer, we can keep it to two people and follow with a deeper technical session.

Agenda (high-level) — 30 minutes:
- 5m: Introductions & goals
- 15m: Product demo (latency/cost controls, routing policies, audit logs)
- 7m: Q&A (esp. around quantization/throughput and private deployment options)
- 3m: Next steps / mutual action plan

I've attached a one-page agenda and a short discovery recap for reference. If you want to lock a time immediately you can use this booking link: https://cal.redwood.ai/book/karthik/30

If none of these windows fit, tell me two times that do and I’ll do my best to accommodate.

Thanks — look forward to aligning calendars.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.ai

Attachments: redwood-30m-demo-agenda.pdf (one-pager), discovery-recap-notes.txt (call notes)

Karthik —

Thanks for the clear recap and the options.

We want to keep this initial session fairly tight: myself (VP Product), Tom (Infra lead), and Priya Shah (Senior Data Engineer). Option B (Wed Oct 21, 2:00–2:30 PM PT) works best for the three of us.

Couple of asks to make the demo most effective:
- Show end-to-end latency numbers for 1k qps bursts and steady state for 50–100 qps;
- A quick example of how audit logs surface model changes; and
- High-level ballpark for cost delta between hosted API vs. dedicated for our typical mix.

We'll accept your calendar invite if you can lock Option B. Please include the meeting link and any prep notes.

Cheers,
Anna
Anna Reyes
VP Product, Lumina Analytics
anna@lumina.ai
